Here are the current populations, annual growth rates, and the fastest-growing city among Lagos, Cairo, and Kinshasa based on recent data:

1. **Kinshasa**: Estimated population of approximately 21.85 million, with an annual growth rate of roughly 5.13%.
2. **Lagos**: Estimated population of approximately 14.88 to 15 million (up to 21 million for the broader metropolitan area), with an annual growth rate of roughly 2.48%.
3. **Cairo**: Estimated city proper population of approximately 10.12 million (up to 22.6 to 23.5 million for the metropolitan area), with an annual growth rate of roughly 1.07% (or up to 1.99% to 2.0% at the metro level).

**Fastest Growing**: Kinshasa is growing the fastest among the three, with an annual growth rate of 5.13%.

Sources:
- [Lagos Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/nigeria/lagos)
- [Cairo Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/egypt/cairo)
- [Kinshasa Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/dr-congo/kinshasa)
